y-m-30-05.title: Ingabe i-rhombus ihlala ibhalwe endingilizini?
y-m-30-05.topic: Isamba sezingosi eziphambene ze-quadrilateral ebhalwe endingilizini
y-m-30-05.goal: Sebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi isamba sezingosi ezimbili eziphambene ze-quadrilateral ebhalwe endingilizini singu-180° njengezinga lokuhlola inkolelo yokuthi 'i-rhombus ihlala ibhalwe', bese wenza amasethi amaningana ezingosi ezine ze-quadrilateral ezihlangabezana nemibandela.
y-m-30-05.material: I-quadrilateral onke ama-vertex ayo amane asendingilizini eyodwa ibizwa ngokuthi 'i-quadrilateral ebhalwe endingilizini'. Kwi-quadrilateral ebhalwe endingilizini, isamba sosayizi bezingosi ezimbili eziphambene singu-180°. UJiho ucabanga, 'I-rhombus, izinhlangothi zayo ezine zonke zilingana, ihlala ibhalwe endingilizini.' (Ku-rhombus, izingosi eziphambene zilingana ngosayizi.)
y-m-30-05.thinking.1: Ukwenza izibonelo eziningana ezihlangabezana nemikhawulo (isamba sezingosi eziphambene, hhayi i-parallelogram)
y-m-30-05.thinking.2: Ukuthola isimo esikhethekile lapho isimangalo sigcina khona
y-m-30-05.prereq.2: Impahla yokuthi isamba sezingosi ezimbili eziphambene ze-quadrilateral ebhalwe endingilizini singu-180° (cabanga ukuthi ingasetshenziswa kulo msebenzi)
y-m-30-05.s.s1.prompt: Kukhona i-rhombus ABCD ene-∠A = 70°. Ingabe le rhombus ingabhalwa endingilizini?
y-m-30-05.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala ukuthi kumele kube nobudlelwano obunjani phakathi kwezingosi eziphambene uma i-quadrilateral ibhalwe.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.hint.1: Thola usayizi wengosi ephambene ne-∠A kule rhombus, bese uhlola ukuthi ubudlelwano obungenhla buyagcina yini.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.o.a: Ibhalwe. Izinhlangothi ezine zilingana, ngakho ama-vertex amane alele endingilizini
y-m-30-05.s.s1.r.a: Cabanga ukuthi ukuba nobude bezinhlangothi obulingana nokuba nama-vertex alele endingilizini eyodwa kuyinto efanayo yini.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.o.b: Ayibhalwanga. Isamba se-∠A nengosi yayo ephambene ∠C singu-140°
y-m-30-05.s.s1.r.b: Lesi yisahlulelo esihlole ukuthi isamba sezingosi ezimbili eziphambene singu-180° yini.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.o.c: Ibhalwe. Ngoba isamba sezingosi ezine singu-360°
y-m-30-05.s.s1.r.c: Isamba sezingosi ezine singu-360° kuyo yonke i-quadrilateral. Cabanga ukuthi liyizinga elingenza isinqumo sokuthi ibhalwe yini.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.r.d: Cabanga ukuthi ungahlulela yini ngisho noma ipheya elilodwa kuphela lezingosi eziphambene lingeyona u-180°.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.explain: Ku-rhombus, ∠C = ∠A = 70°, ngakho ∠A + ∠C = 140° ≠ 180°. Uma ibhalwe, isamba sezingosi ezimbili eziphambene kumele sibe ngu-180°, kodwa asilona, ngakho le rhombus ayibhalwanga endingilizini.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amasethi ama-3 ahlukene osayizi bezingosi ezine (ngamadigri, izinombolo eziphelele) ze-quadrilateral ABCD ebhalwe endingilizini engesiyo i-parallelogram. Izingosi eziphambene ngu-A no-C, no-B no-D. (Lezo ezihluka kuphela ngokulandelana zibalwa njengesibonelo esifanayo.)
y-m-30-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala unqume ∠A, bese unquma ∠C. Ingabe kukhona ubudlelwano phakathi kwezingosi eziphambene?
y-m-30-05.s.s2.hint.1: Nquma ∠B no-∠D ngendlela efanayo, bese uhlola isamba sezingosi ezine nokuthi ∠A no-∠C azilingani.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Zonke izingosi ezine ziyizinombolo eziphelele ezinhle.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Zonke izingosi ezine kumele zibe yizinombolo eziphelele (ngamadigri) ezinkulu kuno-0.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Isamba sempheya ngayinye yezingosi eziphambene singu-180°.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Isamba sezingosi eziphambene (A no-C, B no-D) asiyona u-180°.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.ok.c4: Izingosi eziphambene ziyahluka komunye nomunye, ngakho akuyona i-parallelogram.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.fail.c4: Uma ∠A no-∠C zilingana, kungaba yi-parallelogram. Zenze zihluke komunye nomunye.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.explain: Uma wenza isamba se-∠A no-∠C nesamba se-∠B no-∠D ngasinye sibe ngu-180°, isamba sezingosi ezine siba ngu-360° ngokuzenzakalelayo. Inqobo nje uma ∠A ≠ ∠C, akuyona i-parallelogram. (70°, 80°, 110°, 100°) no-(60°, 90°, 120°, 90°) yizibonelo.
y-m-30-05.s.s3.prompt: Uma kukhona i-rhombus lapho umcabango kaJiho othi 'i-rhombus ihlala ibhalwe endingilizini' ulungile, ingaba i-rhombus enjani? Bhala nesizathu.
y-m-30-05.s.s3.hint.0: Biza ingosi eyodwa ye-rhombus ngokuthi x, bhala ingosi ephambene njengo-x, bese ubhala ukuthi isamba sezingosi ezimbili kumele sibe yinani elinjani.
y-m-30-05.s.s3.hint.1: Chaza ngamazwi isimo se-rhombus enalo x.
y-m-30-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi uma ingosi eyodwa ye-rhombus ingu-x, ingosi ephambene nayo ingu-x?
y-m-30-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi x inqunywa kanjani (2x = 180°)?
y-m-30-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe wenze kwacaca isiphetho sokuthi akuyona yonke i-rhombus?
y-m-30-05.s.s3.model.0: Isikwele. Uma ingosi eyodwa ingu-90°, isamba sezingosi eziphambene singu-90°+90°=180°, ngakho singabhalwa endingilizini.
y-m-30-05.s.s3.model.1: Kuphela i-rhombus onke amazingosi ayo eyizingosi eziqondile, okungukuthi, isikwele, evunyelwe. Izingosi eziphambene ze-rhombus zilingana, ngakho uma ingosi eyodwa ingu-x, khona-ke 2x=180°, ngakho x=90°.

y-m-30-04.title: Ingabe i-engeli ebona i-diameter AB ihlala ingu-90° noma iphoyinti C likuphi?
y-m-30-04.goal: Funda ukuthi 'i-inscribed angle ku-semicircle ingu-90°' iyisimfanelo lapho iphoyinti C lisendingilizini, bese usebenzisa izibonelo ozenzayo ukuhlola futhi usho ukuthi yini eshintshayo lapho iphoyinti elingaphakathi noma ngaphandle kwendingilizi libona i-engeli efanayo.
y-m-30-04.material: Epulanini lezixhumanisi, inkaba yendingilizi O ingumsuka futhi amaphethelo amabili e-diameter AB ngu-A(−5, 0) no-B(5, 0). I-radius yendingilizi ingu-5, futhi iphoyinti C lisendaweni lapho i-y-coordinate inkulu kuno-0. UHyejin usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi 'i-inscribed angle ku-semicircle ingu-90°' ukusho, '∠ACB ingu-90° noma iphoyinti C likuphi.' (∠ACB ifundwa 'angle A C B'.)
y-m-30-04.thinking.0: Ukuhlola izimo lapho isimangalo sibamba khona
y-m-30-04.thinking.1: Ukwenza izibonelo ezanelisa izimo kusukela emaphoyinteni angaphakathi kwendingilizi
y-m-30-04.prereq.0: I-diameter yendingilizi nama-inscribed angle (isimfanelo sokuthi i-inscribed angle ku-semicircle iyi-engeli elungile)
y-m-30-04.prereq.1: Isikhundla sephoyinti epulanini lezixhumanisi nesikwele sebanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili
y-m-30-04.prereq.2: Ukusebenzisa i-theorem kaPythagoras nokuphambene kwayo ukunquma ama-engeli abuthaka nabukhali
y-m-30-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kumagama athi 'i-inscribed angle ku-semicircle', thola ukuthi iphoyinti C kumele libe kuphi.
y-m-30-04.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha iphoyinti elilodwa elingekho endingilizini (isb. iphoyinti eliseduze nje ngaphezu komsuka), lixhume no-A no-B, bese ulinganisela ukuthi ∠ACB inkulu noma incane kune-engeli elungile.
y-m-30-04.s.s1.o.a: Ulungile. Uma kukhona i-diameter AB, ∠ACB ingu-90° noma iphoyinti C likuphi
y-m-30-04.s.s1.r.a: Cabanga ukuthi isimfanelo 'i-inscribed angle ku-semicircle' siyisimo mayelana nokuthi iphoyinti libekwa kuphi yini.
y-m-30-04.s.s1.o.b: Akalungile. Akukho phoyinti C lapho ∠ACB ingu-90° kuphi
y-m-30-04.s.s1.r.b: Cabanga ukuthi ihambisana nesimfanelo esesivele saziwa seliphoyinti C elisendingilizini yini.
y-m-30-04.s.s1.o.c: Angikazi okwamanje. Isimfanelo esasifundile singasetshenziswa kuphela lapho C isendingilizini
y-m-30-04.s.s1.r.c: Lesi yisinqumo esacabanga ngesimo lapho isimfanelo sisebenza khona futhi sacabanga ukuthi ngaphandle kwebanga lokusebenza kudingeka ukuqinisekiswa okwengeziwe.
y-m-30-04.s.s1.o.d: Ulungile. Kodwa kuphela uma ubude be-AC ne-BC bulingana
y-m-30-04.s.s1.r.d: Uma AC = BC, khona iphoyinti C lise-y-axis. Cabanga ukuthi i-engeli iyafana kuwo wonke amaphoyinti kuyo yini.
y-m-30-04.s.s1.explain: Isimfanelo sokuthi i-inscribed angle ku-semicircle ingu-90° mayelana nalapho iphoyinti C lisendingilizini (iphoyinti elingelona elise-diameter AB). Amaphoyinti angaphakathi noma ngaphandle kwendingilizi kumele ahlolwe ngokwehlukana.
y-m-30-04.s.s2.prompt: Khetha amaphoyinti C(x, y) angaphakathi kwendingilizi lapho i-x-coordinate ne-y-coordinate kuyizinombolo eziphelele, bese wenza izibonelo ezi-3 ezihlukile lapho ∠ACB inkulu kune-engeli elungile (ibuthaka). Iphoyinti C line-y > 0 futhi lingaphakathi kwendingilizi. (Amaphoyinti amabili alinganisiwe kwesobunxele nakwesokudla abalwa njengesibonelo esifanayo.)
y-m-30-04.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha iphoyinti C, thola izikwele zobude be-AC ne-BC, bese uqhathanisa isamba sazo nesikwele se-AB, 100.
y-m-30-04.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ngamaphoyinti amabili ukuthi ukuqhathanisa okungenhla kuhluka kanjani lapho isikwele sebanga kusuka emsukeni kuya ku-C sincane futhi sikhulu kunesikwele sika-5.
y-m-30-04.s.s2.fail.c1: x no-y kumele kube yizinombolo eziphelele.
y-m-30-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Iphoyinti C kumele libe endaweni lapho y > 0.
y-m-30-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Iphoyinti C alingaphakathi kwendingilizi. Hlola ukuthi isikwele sebanga kusuka emsukeni kuya ku-C sincane kuno-25 yini.
y-m-30-04.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, uma C(0, 1), khona AC² = 26 no-BC² = 26, futhi isamba singu-52, esincane kuno-AB² = 100, ngakho ∠ACB ibuthaka. C(3, 4) liphoyinti elisendingilizini, ngakho i-engeli elungile, futhi C(4, 4) likhona ngaphandle kwendingilizi, ngakho AC² + BC² = 114 > 100, okwenza ibukhali.
y-m-30-04.s.s3.prompt: Ephoyintini C ngaphandle kwendingilizi (y > 0), ∠ACB inkulu noma incane kuno-90°? Khetha iphoyinti bese uhlola ngezinombolo, bese uhlela futhi ubhale ukuthi ∠ACB ishintsha kanjani kuye ngesikhundla sephoyinti C (ngaphakathi kwendingilizi, endingilizini, ngaphandle kwendingilizi).
y-m-30-04.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha iphoyinti elingaphandle kwendingilizi bese wenza ukuqhathanisa okufanayo nakusi-s2 (AC² + BC² no-AB²).
y-m-30-04.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ethebuleni ukuthi umphumela walokho kuqhathanisa uhluka kanjani ngaphakathi kwendingilizi, endingilizini, nangaphandle kwendingilizi.
y-m-30-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kuphoyinti engilikhethile, ingabe ngiqhathanise ngqo osayizi be-AC², BC², no-AB²?
y-m-30-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngikhulume ngazo zonke izimo ezintathu: ngaphakathi, endingilizini, nangaphandle kwendingilizi?
y-m-30-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ngisho isiqondiso soshintsho, njengokuthi 'njengoba iphoyinti lisuka kude nakakhulu'?
y-m-30-04.s.s3.model.0: Ukubheka iphoyinti C(4, 4) elingaphandle kwendingilizi, AC²=81+16=97, BC²=1+16=17, futhi isamba 114 sikhulu kuno-AB²=100, ngakho ∠ACB yingosi encane engaphansi kuka-90°. Ngokufinyeziwe, ngaphakathi kwendingilizi inkulu, endingilizini iyingosi eqondile, nangaphandle kwendingilizi incane.
y-m-30-04.s.s3.model.1: Iphoyinti (6, 1) elingaphandle kwendingilizi linebanga elisikwelwe elingu-37 kusukela ku-origin, elikhulu kuno-25. Khona-ke ∠ACB incane kuno-90°. Uma C isuka kude nakakhulu no-AB, ingosi iba mxinwa, futhi ingu-90° ngqo endingilizini kuphela.

y-m-30-02.title: Ukulinganisela ubude besigxobo se-flag kusukela ku-engeli yokuphakama engu-35°
y-m-30-02.topic: Ukusebenzisa izilinganiso ze-trigonometric (ukuthola ubude kusukela ku-engeli yokuphakama)
y-m-30-02.goal: Funda ukuthi i-engeli yokuphakama yodwa ayinquli ubude, khetha ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olwengeziwe oludingekayo, uhlole ukuthi ubude bamehlo kumele bengezwe, bese uqagela umphumela iphutha ekukaleni i-engeli elinawo emphumeleni.
y-m-30-02.material: Ufuna ukuthola ubude besigxobo se-flag epulazini lesikole. Umhlaba uyisicaba futhi isigxobo se-flag simi ngqo emhlabeni. Umi endaweni ekude nesigxobo se-flag uphakamisa amehlo uyobheka phezulu, ukale i-engeli yokubheka phezulu (i-engeli yokuphakama) futhi yayingu-35°. Awukakali okunye. Isethenjwa: tan 35° ingu-0.7002 cishe, sin 35° ingu-0.5736 cishe, futhi cos 35° ingu-0.8192 cishe. 'tan' ifundwa 'tangent'.
y-m-30-02.thinking.1: Ukuthola ukuhlanganiswa okuhlukile kolwazi okuholela emphumeleni ofanayo
y-m-30-02.prereq.0: Incazelo yezilinganiso ze-trigonometric (sine, cosine, tangent) ye-engeli kunxantathu ofanele
y-m-30-02.prereq.1: Ukufunda ithebula lamanani ezilinganiso ze-trigonometric noma ukusebenzisa amanani alinganiselwe anikeziwe
y-m-30-02.s.s1.prompt: Uthole kuphela i-engeli yokuphakama engu-35°. Yini enye odinga ukuyazi ukuze unqume ubude besigxobo se-flag? Khetha konke okudingekayo. (Kungase kube khona ukuhlanganiswa okuhlukile okufanelekile.)
y-m-30-02.s.s1.hint.0: Chaza ngamagama unxantathu ofanele i-engeli yokuphakama eyakhayo. Uhlangothi ngalunye lusuka kuliphi iphoyinti luye kuliphi?
y-m-30-02.s.s1.hint.1: Phakathi kwezinhlangothi zalowo nxantathu, hlukanisa ezo osuvele uzazi nezo ongazazi, futhi uhlole nokuthi ubude buqala emhlabeni noma emehlweni.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.o.a: Ibanga elivundlile elingu-20 m kusuka lapho umi kuya phansi kwesigxobo se-flag
y-m-30-02.s.s1.r.a: Ngebanga elivundlile, kanye ne-engeli yokuphakama, unganquma ubude obukhuphukile kusuka emehlweni kuya phezulu.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.o.b: Ibanga elingumugqa oqondile kusuka emehlweni kuya phezulu, cishe 24.4 m
y-m-30-02.s.s1.r.b: Ibanga elingumugqa oqondile, elibhanqwe ne-engeli yokuphakama, nalo likuvumela ukunquma ubude. Kodwa kunzima ukulikala ngqo.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.o.c: Ubude kusuka emhlabeni kuya emehlweni, 1.5 m
y-m-30-02.s.s1.r.c: Uma uthola kuphela ubude ngaphezu kwamehlo, akuyona ubude kusuka emhlabeni kuya phezulu. Cabanga ngokuthi ubude busuka kuphi buya kuphi.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.r.d: Ubukhulu bulolwazi olungahlangene nobude bephezulu. Cabanga ukuthi bubude obungena kunxantathu onquma ubude yini.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuthola ubude ngaphezu kwamehlo kusuka ku-engeli yokuphakama, udinga okunye ubude (ibanga elivundlile noma ibanga elingumugqa oqondile). Futhi, lobo bude busuka emehlweni buya phezulu, ngakho ukuthola ubude kusuka emhlabeni kuya phezulu, kumele wengeze ubude bamehlo.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.acc.0: Noma wazi ibanga elingumugqa oqondile kusuka emehlweni kuya phezulu, kanye ne-engeli yokuphakama ungaqonda ubude ngaphezu kwamehlo, bese wengeza ubude bamehlo. Kodwa, kunzima ukukala ibanga elingumugqa oqondile ngqo, ngakho ukusebenzisa ibanga elivundlile kuyiqiniso kakhulu.
y-m-30-02.s.s2.prompt: Manje usukale ibanga elivundlile elingu-20 m nobude bamehlo obungu-1.5 m. Iliphi inani elifaneleke kakhulu lobude besigxobo se-flag? (tan 35° ≈ 0.7002)
y-m-30-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kunxantathu ofanele one-engeli yokuphakama njengenye i-engeli, nquma ukuthi u-20 m nobude ofuna ukubuthola kuyizinhlangothi eseduze nale ngeli nephambene nayo yini.

y-m-30-02.s.s2.r.a: Kungenzeka usebenzise isilinganiso se-trigonometric esihlukile, ngebanga elivundlile njengohlangothi oluseduze, ukuthola ubude ngaphezu kwamehlo. Hlola futhi ukuthi isilinganiso sisuka kuluphi uhlangothi siye kuluphi.

y-m-30-02.s.s2.r.d: Kungenzeka usebenzise isilinganiso se-trigonometric esingahambisani nobudlelwano phakathi kwebanga elivundlile nobude. Hlola futhi ukuthi uhlangothi olwaziwayo nolo ofuna ukuluthola luyini ngalunye.
y-m-30-02.s.s2.explain: Ubude ngaphezu kwamehlo bungu-20×tan 35° ≈ 20×0.7002 ≈ 14.0 m, futhi ukwengeza ubude bamehlo obungu-1.5 m kunikeza cishe 15.5 m.
y-m-30-02.s.s3.prompt: Isixhumi sokukala i-engeli yokuphakama sinephutha, ngakho i-engeli yangempela yokuphakama ingaba ngu-34° noma 36°. Ukubala ubude besigxobo se-flag kushintsha kanjani ngaleso sikhathi? Bhala usebenzisa okungenani inombolo eyodwa, bese wengeza umugqa owodwa ngokuthi ungathemba kangakanani u-15.5 m. (Isethenjwa: tan 34° ≈ 0.6745, tan 36° ≈ 0.7265)
y-m-30-02.s.s3.hint.0: Bala izimo ze-34° ne-36° ngokulandelana okufanayo nokokuqala.
y-m-30-02.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa nenani ku-35° bese uhlola ukuthi ahluke kangakanani ngokukhipha.

y-m-30-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ngezinombolo ukuthi ubude bushintsha kangakanani ngisho noma i-engeli iphambuka nge-1° kuphela?

y-m-30-06.title: Ingabe indawo kanxantathu onezinhlangothi ezimbili ezingu-6 no-10 iyanqunywa?
y-m-30-06.topic: Indawo kanxantathu (izinhlangothi ezimbili nengosi ephakathi kwazo)
y-m-30-06.goal: Funda ukuthi ubude bezinhlangothi ezimbili kuphela abunquli indawo kanxantathu, hlukanisa ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olwengeziwe olunquma, bese uchaza ukuthi kukhona onxantathu abanendawo efanayo kodwa izimo ezihlukile.
y-m-30-06.material: Kunxantathu ABC, wazi kuphela ukuthi AB = 6 cm no-AC = 10 cm, futhi awukazi usayizi we-∠A. Njengoba kunxantathu, 0° < ∠A < 180°. Indawo ingatholakala ngo-½ × AB × AC × sin A ('sin A' ifundwa 'sine A'). Amanani okubhekwa: sin 30° = 1/2, sin 60° = (√3)/2 ≈ 0.866, sin 90° = 1, sin 150° = 1/2. I-sine yengosi enkulu ilingana ne-sine yengosi encane etholwa ngokususa leyo ngosi ku-180° (isib., sin 150° = sin 30°).
y-m-30-06.thinking.1: Ukuthola zonke izimpendulo ezihlangabezana nombandela ofanayo
y-m-30-06.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ukuthi izimo ziyahluka ngendawo efanayo
y-m-30-06.prereq.0: Isisho sendawo kanxantathu usebenzisa izinhlangothi ezimbili ne-sine yengosi ephakathi kwazo (½ × umphumela wezinhlangothi ezimbili × sin(ingosi ephakathi))
y-m-30-06.prereq.1: Amanani afana no-sin 30°, sin 90°, sin 150° (iqiniso lokuthi i-sine yengosi enkulu ilingana ne-sine yengosi encane etholwa ngokuyisusa ku-180° linikezwe embhalweni)
y-m-30-06.prereq.2: Imibandela yokufana konxantathu (uma izinhlangothi ezintathu zinqunyiwe, unxantathu unqunywa njengoyedwa)
y-m-30-06.s.s1.prompt: Ngaphezu kuka-AB = 6 no-AC = 10, khetha zonke izimo lapho indawo kanxantathu inqunywa njengenani elilodwa uma elilodwa kulokhu okulandelayo laziwa.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kucezu ngalunye lolwazi, sebenza ngokwehlukana ukuthi ungenziwa unxantathu oyedwa kuphela noma abaningana.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kwethi 'ingosi encane', thola amanani amabili noma ngaphezulu angenzeka e-∠A bese uqhathanisa izindawo.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.r.a: Cabanga ukuthi inani le-sin A liyahluka ngezindlela eziningana ngisho nangaphakathi kobubanzi bezingosi ezincane.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.r.b: Cabanga ukuthi unxantathu unqunywa njengoyedwa uma zonke izinhlangothi ezintathu zinqunyiwe.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.r.c: Cabanga ukuthi, uma wazi ingosi ephakathi, ungathola ngqo indawo ngefomula.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.o.d: Unxantathu akayena unxantathu onezinhlangothi ezimbili ezilinganayo
y-m-30-06.s.s1.r.d: Cabanga ukuthi lolu lwazi lunquma ∠A njengenani elilodwa yini.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.explain: Uma wazi ingosi ephakathi ∠A = 60°, indawo inqunywa njengo-½×6×10×sin 60° = 15√3 ≈ 26.0 cm². Uma BC = 8, izinhlangothi ezintathu zinqunyiwe ngakho unxantathu unqunywa njengoyedwa (empeleni 6, 8, 10 unxantathu onengosi eqondile ku-B, ngakho indawo ingu-½×6×8 = 24 cm²), futhi indawo nayo inqunywa njengenani elilodwa. 'Incane' noma 'akayena unxantathu onezinhlangothi ezimbili ezilinganayo' akunquli ∠A njengenani elilodwa.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.prompt: Ukuze indawo ibe ngu-15 cm² ngqo, ∠A kumele ibe yini? Khetha zonke ezingenzeka.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.hint.0: Kuyo yonke ∠A engenzeka, bala inani lika-½×6×10×sin A bese uliqhathanisa no-15.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ngokuxazulula isibalo sendawo ½×6×10×sin A = 15 njengesibalo ku-sin A bese uthola inani le-sin A.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.r.a: Uma ungahlolanga ukuthi inani le-sin liyini engosini enkulu, leli yinani elilula ukulishiya.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.r.b: Uma ubala indawo yengosi eqondile ngqo, ungahlola ukuthi iphuma ingu-15 yini.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.r.c: Leli yinani owahlola indawo ngalo usebenzisa u-sin 30° = 1/2.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.r.d: Uma ubala indawo ngenani le-sin 60°, ungahlola ukuthi iphuma ingu-15 yini.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.explain: Indawo = ½×6×10×sin A = 30 sin A = 15 inika sin A = 1/2. Phakathi kuka-0° no-180°, kunezingosi ezimbili ezinga-sin A = 1/2: 30° no-150°. Ku-90° indawo ingu-30, futhi ku-60° ingu-26.0 cishe.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.prompt: Onxantathu ababili abenziwe ngezingosi ezimbili owazithola esi-s2 baneAB = 6, AC = 10 futhi bobabili banendawo engu-15 cm². Kodwa onxantathu ababili abanawo isimo esifanayo. Chaza okungenani indlela eyodwa onxantathu ababili abahluka ngayo.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.hint.0: Qhathanisa ukuthi yiluphi uhlangothi olude kakhulu kunxantathu ngamunye kwababili.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.hint.1: Thatha i-AC njengesisekelo bese uqhathanisa ukuphakama okudwetshwe kusuka ku-B ezimeni ezimbili.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uchaze ngezinombolo ukuthi yini ehluka phakathi konxantathu ababili (ubude be-BC, njll.)?
y-m-30-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlukanise isizathu sokuthi izindawo ziyafana (ukuphakama kuyafana, inani le-sin liyafana) nesizathu sokuthi izimo ziyahluka?
y-m-30-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usho ukuthi yimuphi phakathi kwabo ababili ongunxantathu onengosi enkulu?
y-m-30-06.s.s3.model.0: Uma ∠A=30°, ∠A incane futhi BC icishe ibe ngu-5.7 cm, kodwa ku-150° inkulu futhi BC icishe ibe ngu-15.5 cm, mude kakhulu. Ngisho noma indawo ifana, 15, isimo siyahluka.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.model.1: Kuzo zombili, uma uthatha i-AC njengesisekelo 10, ukuphakama okudwetshwe kusuka ku-B kuyafana, 3 cm, ngakho izindawo ziyafana. Kodwa ku-150°, u-B uphambukele ekwandiseni kwe-AC, ngakho isimo siyahluka.

y-m-30-03.title: Ukulinganisela ibanga kusuka kuphoyinti ngaphandle kwendingilizi kuya ephoyintini lokuthinta
y-m-30-03.topic: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-tangent yendingilizi ne-radius yayo
y-m-30-03.goal: Hamba ngenqubo lapho ubude be-tangent, obekungakwazi ukunikezwa njengebanga kuphela ekuqaleni, buba nqunyiwe lapho kungezwa ulwazi lokuthi i-tangent ime ngqo ku-radius, bese unquma ukuthi isizathu esifanayo sisebenza kwi-tangent yesibili yini.
y-m-30-03.material: Kunendingilizi O ene-radius engu-5 cm. Kusuka ephoyintini P ngaphandle kwendingilizi, dweba i-tangent kuyo indingilizi, bese ubiza iphoyinti lokuthinta ngo-A. Ibanga kusuka enkabeni O kuya ephoyintini P lingu-13 cm. Ufuna ukuthola ubude be-tangent PA. (Akukho sithombe. Cabanga unxantathu onamaphoyinti amathathu O, A, P njengama-vertex awo.)

y-m-30-03.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi lembulwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Nquma usebenzisa kuphela ulwazi kuze kube yileso sinyathelo, futhi ungase uvuselele isinqumo sakho ngemva kokubona ulwazi olulandelayo.

y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Lokho owaziyo manje: OA = 5 cm (radius), OP = 13 cm. Iphoyinti A liphoyinti elisendingilizini futhi PA i-tangent yale ndingilizi. Ungasisebenzisi isimfanelo se-tangent okwamanje.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Uma O, A, P zingekho emugqeni owodwa, kwakheka unxantathu OAP. Kunxantathu, isamba sezinhlangothi ezimbili sikhulu kunohlangothi olusele, ngakho PA inkulu kuno-13 − 5 = 8 futhi incane kuno-13 + 5 = 18. U-8 ibanga elifushane kakhulu kusuka ephoyintini P kuya endingilizini, futhi akuwona ubude be-tangent. Okwamanje ungasho kuphela ibanga.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kungenzeka uxubanise ibanga elifushane kakhulu kusuka ephoyintini P kuya endingilizini nobude be-tangent. Cabanga ukuthi iphoyinti A liyisikhundla esenza leli banga yini.

y-m-30-07.goal: Thola ibanga elisuka maphakathi liye ku-chord, bese wahlulela futhi ubhale ukuthi impendulo iphelele kuphela uma ucabangela kokubili isimo lapho ama-chord amabili afanayo asohlangothini olufanayo lwaphakathi nesimo lapho esezinhlangothini ezihlukene.
y-m-30-07.material: Endingilizini O ene-radius engu-13 cm, kukhona i-chord AB yobude obungu-24 cm ne-chord CD yobude obungu-10 cm. Ama-chord amabili afana komunye. Asikho isithombe esinikeziwe. Ufuna ukuthola ibanga phakathi kwama-chord amabili. (Umugqa oqondile odwetshwe usuka maphakathi nendingilizi uye ku-chord uhlukanisa leyo chord ibe yingxenye.)

y-m-30-07.s.s1.prompt: I-chord ngayinye isekude kangakanani maphakathi nendingilizi O?
y-m-30-07.s.s1.hint.0: Chaza ngamazwi unxantathu onama-vertex angama-foot omugqa oqondile, isiphetho esisodwa se-chord, nephakathi O, bese uthola lapho ingosi eqondile ikhona.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ngemva kokunquma ukuthi yiluphi uhlangothi olude kakhulu kulowo nxantathu, bhala isisho esithola uhlangothi olusele ezinhlangothini ezimbili ezaziwayo.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.a: Kungenzeka ucabange ukuthi uma i-chord ide, isekude nakakhulu maphakathi. Yenza unxantathu oqondile ngengxenye ye-chord ne-radius ukuhlola.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.b: Kungenzeka uyithole ngokususa nje ingxenye ye-chord ku-radius. Hlola ukuthi yiluphi uhlangothi oluyi-hypotenuse.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.c: Leli yinani elisebenzise iqiniso lokuthi umugqa oqondile usuka maphakathi uye ku-chord udlula maphakathi nesiphetho se-chord.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.d: Kungenzeka wengeze isikwele sengxenye ye-chord esikweleni se-radius. Hlola ukuthi yiluphi uhlangothi oluyi-hypotenuse.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.explain: I-foot yomugqa oqondile osuka ku-O uye ku-AB iyindawo ephakathi ye-AB, futhi kunxantathu oqondile owenziwe ngobude obuyingxenye obungu-12 ne-radius engu-13, ibanga lingu-√(13² − 12²) = 5. Ku-CD, ubude obuyingxenye bungu-5, ngakho √(13² − 5²) = 12. Uma i-chord ide, isondele maphakathi.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.prompt: Ngezansi kunesixazululo esithole ibanga phakathi kwama-chord amabili. Khetha umugqa onomcabango obekwe ngaphandle kwesizathu. Bala izinombolo zemigqa kusukela ku-1.

y-m-30-07.s.s2.line.3: Ngakho ibanga phakathi kwama-chord amabili lingu-12 − 5 = 7 cm.

y-m-30-07.s.s3.prompt: Dweba isimo lapho ama-chord amabili esezinhlangothini ezihlukene zephakathi O. Thola ibanga lapho, bese ubhala ukuthi impendulo yalolu daba kufanele ibhalwe kanjani.

y-m-30-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usho isizathu sokuthi ngaphandle kwesithombe izindawo azinqunywanga?

y-m-30-08.title: Induku ende kakhulu engena ebhokisini
y-m-30-08.topic: I-diagonal yebhokisi lesikwele esinde (kusetshenziswa umbono kaPythagoras ngezinhlangothi ezintathu)
y-m-30-08.goal: Uma uthola ubude besigaba esimeni esiqinile, sebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi i-diagonal yesisekelo nokuphakama kwenza ingosi eqondile, yenza amabhokisi lapho ubude be-diagonal bungu-inombolo yemvelo ngezindlela eziningana, bese wahlulela ukuthi induku ingena yini.
y-m-30-08.material: Kunebhokisi eliyisikwele esinde elingenalutho ububanzi obungu-3 cm, ubujulile obungu-4 cm, nokuphakama okungu-12 cm. Ufuna ukufaka induku encane kakhulu engagobi ngokuphelele ngaphakathi kwalelibhokisi. Zibele ubukhulu bebhokisi, futhi cabanga ukuthi izilinganiso zangaphakathi zifana nezangaphandle. Ufuna ukuthola ubude benduku ende kakhulu engangena ngaphakathi kwebhokisi.
y-m-30-08.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano bezindawo bemicibisholo nobuso bebhokisi lesikwele esinde (isisekelo nokuphakama kuqondene)
y-m-30-08.s.s1.prompt: Ngezansi kunesixazululo lapho umfundi athole khona ubude benduku ende kakhulu. Khetha umugqa owodwa ophosile. Bala izinombolo zemigqa kusukela ku-1.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.hint.0: Chaza ngamazwi ukuthi induku ilala kanjani iyekelezile kusuka onqenqemeni olulodwa lwebhokisi kuya onqenqemeni olungenhla oluphambene, futhi ubheke ukuthi u-5 no-12 emgqeni 3 benza i-engeli yini komunye nomunye.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.hint.1: Dweba unxantathu owenziwe izingxenye ezimbili zika-5 cm no-12 cm nenduku. Hlola usebenzisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlangothi zikanxantathu ukuthi ubude bezinhlangothi ezintathu bungaba ngu-5, 12, 17.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.line.1: Ubude be-diagonal yesisekelo bungu-3² + 4² = 25, ngakho ngu-5.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.line.2: Induku ilala emumweni oxhuma i-diagonal yesisekelo engu-5 nokuphakama okungu-12, ngakho 5 + 12 = 17.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho induku ende kakhulu ingu-17 cm.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uyinkinga. Induku idlula iyekelezile kusuka ekhoneni elilodwa lesisekelo kuya ekhoneni elingenhla eliphambene, ngakho i-diagonal yesisekelo (5) nokuphakama (12) kunjalo ngokuya kwesisekelo bese induku iyi-hypotenuse yonxantathu olungile onalezo ezimbili njengezinhlangothi zawo. I-hypotenuse akuyona isamu lezinhlangothi ezimbili kodwa impande yesikwele yesamu lezikwele zazo, ngakho imfushane. Ngakho u-17 cm emgqeni 4 nawo uphosile. Ngokubala ngokulungile, √(5² + 12²) = 13 cm.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.prompt: Phakathi kwamabhokisi ane-rectangle lapho ububanzi a, ukujula b, nokuphakama c konke kuyizinombolo zemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-12, yenza amabhokisi angu-3 ahlukile lapho ubude benduku ende kakhulu efaka ngaphakathi nabo buyinombolo yemvelo. (Amabhokisi anama-a, b, c ngokulandelana okuhlukile kuphela ayibhokisi elifanayo.)
y-m-30-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nquma ubude obubili kwezintathu futhi uthole isikwele se-diagonal yesisekelo, bese ushintsha ukuphakama futhi uhlole ukuthi isamu eliphelele liba isikwele senombolo ethile yini.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa amabhokisi owatholile nokokuqala u-3, 4, 12, futhi uzame ngokulandelana uqale ngezinombolo ezincane ngendlela efanayo.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.ok.c1: Ubude obuthathu buyizinombolo zemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-12.

y-m-30-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Ubude benduku ende kakhulu buyinombolo yemvelo.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Ubude benduku ende kakhulu (impande yesikwele yesamu lezikwele zobude obuthathu) abuyona inombolo yemvelo.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, u-(1, 2, 2) unika u-√9 = 3, u-(2, 3, 6) unika u-√49 = 7, u-(4, 4, 7) unika u-√81 = 9, futhi u-(2, 4, 4) unika u-√36 = 6. Ibhokisi lokuqala (3, 4, 12) linika u-√169 = 13, ngakho lingelinye lamabhokisi anelisa lesi simo.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.prompt: Faka induku ebhokisini elinobubanzi obungu-3, ukujula okungu-4, nokuphakama okungu-12. Ubudlelwano obufaneleke kakhulu phakathi kobude benduku nebhokisi buyini? (13 cm ubude benduku ende kakhulu.)
